description: Verified exam notes for 5 November 2026 covering fiscal federalism, Aadhaar governance, critical minerals, defence technology, astronomy, watershed policy, rooftop solar, cultural digitisation and artisan livelihoods.

stories.title: Union advances ₹1,09,019 crore regular tax-devolution instalment to States
stories.summary: The Union Government released the regular monthly tax-devolution instalment of ₹1,09,019 crore on 5 November, advancing it from its normal 10 November date. The Finance Ministry described the move as support for State capital spending and development and welfare expenditure during the festive season; it was an accelerated release, not a new tax-sharing formula.
key_facts: Tamil Nadu received ₹4,466 crore from the instalment.
The instalment was released on 5 November instead of the normally scheduled 10 November.
Tax devolution transfers States' constitutionally determined share of divisible-pool Union taxes.
stories.exam_link: Revise Article 270, the divisible pool, the Finance Commission under Article 280 and the distinction between tax devolution and grants-in-aid.
stories.source_title: Ministry of Finance — Advance release of regular tax devolution, 5 November 2026

stories.title: UIDAI expands Aadhaar offline-verification ecosystem to 300 entities
stories.summary: UIDAI reported that 300 Offline Verification Seeking Entities had been onboarded since the ecosystem's January rollout. Aadhaar offline verification is designed for consent-based, paperless identity checks without a live query to UIDAI's central database, with user control and data minimisation central to the model.
key_facts: OVSE means Offline Verification Seeking Entity.
The ecosystem covers sectors such as hospitality, healthcare, education, events, the gig economy and other consumer-facing services.
The Aadhaar App had recorded nearly 7.5 crore downloads by the date of the release.
UIDAI is a statutory authority established under the Aadhaar Act, 2016.
stories.exam_link: Connect the development with digital public infrastructure, consent-based identity verification, data minimisation and the statutory role of UIDAI.

stories.title: DRDO successfully flight-tests indigenous Pralay missile
stories.summary: DRDO successfully flight-tested the indigenous quasi-ballistic missile Pralay from Dr APJ Abdul Kalam Island off Odisha at about 11:10 a.m. The user-evaluation trial met all stipulated objectives, as validated by range instruments of the Integrated Test Range, Chandipur; the release said the successful test brought induction closer.
key_facts: Pralay is described as an indigenous quasi-ballistic missile.
Research Centre Imarat, Hyderabad, developed it with other DRDO laboratories.
Bharat Dynamics Limited is one of its development-cum-production partners.
The trial took place from Dr APJ Abdul Kalam Island off the Odisha coast.
stories.exam_link: Revise DRDO, Bharat Dynamics Limited, the Integrated Test Range at Chandipur and the distinction between development tests and user-evaluation trials.
stories.source_title: Ministry of Defence — Pralay flight-test, 5 November 2026

stories.title: Ninth critical-mineral auction and third exploration-licence auction launched
stories.summary: The Ministry of Mines launched the ninth e-auction tranche for critical and strategic mineral blocks and the third tranche for exploration-licence blocks. The announcement starts competitive auction processes; it does not mean that mining leases or exploration licences have already been awarded.
key_facts: Twenty critical and strategic mineral blocks were offered in the ninth tranche.
The earlier eight tranches had offered 100 unique blocks, of which 64 had been successfully auctioned.
The third exploration-licence tranche offered 14 blocks across six States.
Exploration licences enable private participation in prospecting for specified critical and deep-seated minerals before mining begins.
stories.exam_link: Study the Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Act, exploration licences, critical-mineral supply chains and the National Critical Mineral Mission.
stories.source_title: Ministry of Mines — Critical mineral and exploration-licence auctions, 5 November 2026

stories.title: Indian-led study reclassifies UBC 63 as two star clusters
stories.summary: An Indian-led research team found that UBC 63, earlier treated as one Galactic open cluster, actually consists of UBC 63A and UBC 63B. Gaia astrometry, stellar colour-magnitude analysis, machine learning and dynamical simulations indicated that the differently aged clusters underwent a close flyby and are now moving apart.
key_facts: UBC 63 lies about 4,892 light-years from Earth.
UBC 63A is estimated to be about 21 million years old, while UBC 63B is about 562 million years old.
The clusters passed within roughly 7 parsecs of each other about 6 million years ago.
The European Space Agency's Gaia mission supplied precise stellar-position and motion data used in the work.
stories.exam_link: Revise open star clusters, parsec and light-year units, colour-magnitude diagrams, astrometry and the scientific role of ESA's Gaia mission.
stories.source_title: Department of Science and Technology — UBC 63 double-cluster study, 5 November 2026

stories.title: Draft national technical guidelines discussed for science-based watershed management
stories.summary: NRAA, ICAR-NBSS&LUP and the Department of Land Resources held a national consultation in Nagpur on draft technical guidelines for improved watershed management under the World Bank-assisted REWARD programme. The proposals emphasise scientific baselines, land-resource inventories, decision-support systems and community participation; the guidelines were still being finalised.
key_facts: The two-day consultation was held on 4–5 November 2026 at ICAR-NBSS&LUP, Nagpur.
REWARD expands to Rejuvenating Watersheds for Agricultural Resilience through Innovative Development.
The draft is intended to inform future programmes, including WDC-PMKSY 3.0.
Suggested tools include digital soil libraries, GIS, remote sensing, hydrological assessment and land-resource inventories.
stories.exam_link: Link watershed management with rainfed agriculture, soil and water conservation, PMKSY, drought resilience, GIS and participatory natural-resource governance.
stories.source_title: Ministry of Rural Development — Watershed technical-guidelines consultation, 5 November 2026

stories.title: 2,576 government financial-sector buildings solarised under PM Surya Ghar
stories.summary: A government update reported rooftop-solar installations on 2,576 feasible buildings among 4,144 buildings identified across participating public financial-sector organisations under PM Surya Ghar. Installed capacity reached 61.50 MW against 62.70 MW assessed as feasible; the figures describe completed installations in this identified set.
key_facts: The Prime Minister launched PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana on 13 February 2024.
The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy is the nodal ministry for the scheme.
SBI accounted for 841 solarised buildings in the reported organisation-wise table.
The gap between feasible and installed capacity was attributed to structural and shading constraints.
stories.exam_link: Revise rooftop solar, distributed generation, CAPEX and OPEX implementation models, and the role of MNRE in India's energy transition.
stories.source_title: Government update — Solarisation of government buildings under PM Surya Ghar, 5 November 2026

stories.title: Culture Ministry and Google Arts & Culture sign heritage-digitisation MoU
stories.summary: The Ministry of Culture signed a memorandum of understanding with Google Arts & Culture to digitise and share India's cultural heritage. The development establishes a collaboration framework for digital access and dissemination; it should not be read as confirmation that every collection has already been digitised.
key_facts: The agreement pairs the Union Ministry of Culture with Google Arts & Culture.
Its stated purpose is to digitise and share India's cultural heritage.
Digitisation can support documentation, preservation, education and wider public access to heritage collections.
stories.exam_link: Connect the MoU with tangible and intangible cultural heritage, museum digitisation, archival preservation and the Ministry of Culture's institutional role.
stories.source_title: Ministry of Culture — Heritage digitisation MoU, 5 November 2026

stories.title: MSME Ministry and TRIFED partner on market access for PM Vishwakarma artisans
stories.summary: The Ministry of MSME signed an MoU with TRIFED to strengthen market access for artisans supported under PM Vishwakarma. The agreement is a market-linkage initiative and does not itself constitute a new cash benefit or a change in eligibility under the scheme.
key_facts: PM Vishwakarma was launched on 17 September 2023 for artisans and craftspeople in traditional trades.
The scheme combines recognition, skill upgradation, toolkit support, concessional credit, digital-transaction incentives and market linkages.
TRIFED functions under the Ministry of Tribal Affairs and promotes products and livelihoods of tribal communities.
stories.exam_link: Revise PM Vishwakarma, the Ministry of MSME, TRIFED, tribal marketing institutions and the importance of market linkages for traditional occupations.
stories.source_title: Ministry of MSME — MoU with TRIFED for PM Vishwakarma artisans, 5 November 2026
